description: Evaluation set for RagBot on the Satisfactory Wiki (satisfactory.wiki.gg, --site satisfactory). Questions are phrased the way a player would ask. expected_urls: pages that contain the answer (any one counts as a hit). An empty list means the wiki does not answer it, so the correct response is 'I don't know'. reference: the key facts from the page (checked against the crawl of 2026-11-06), used by the answer judge.

questions.question: How much power does a Mk.1 Miner use?
How many items per minute can a Mk.1 conveyor belt move?
How much water does a Water Extractor pump per minute?
questions.reference: 120 m³ of water per minute (at 100% clock speed).

questions.question: What materials do I need to build a Smelter?
How much power does a Nuclear Power Plant generate?
How many Somersloops are there in the world?
Where do I find Hard Drives, and how many are there?
questions.reference: In Crash Sites; there are 118 Crash Sites, each with one Hard Drive, so 118 Hard Drives.

questions.question: What range can I set a building's clock speed to?
What are Power Shards for, and how do I get them?
questions.reference: They are used for overclocking buildings. They come from hunting and processing Power Slugs; synthetic production becomes available in Tier 9.

questions.question: What does it cost to build the Space Elevator?
questions.reference: 500 Concrete, 250 Iron Plate, 400 Iron Rod and 1,500 Wire.

questions.question: What do I need to craft an AI Limiter?
questions.reference: 5 Copper Sheet and 20 Quickwire, made in an Assembler (12 seconds per cycle).
